meta.rows_old_library: cases a and c only, library sim/out/mpc_library.json
meta.case_e: world_model estimated (local wave fit, radar + forward scanner), wind from the estimator
meta.energy_trend: (E_end - E_start)/(t_end - t_start) * 60 over the last 60 s flown, E = g z + V^2/2

meta.planner_world_truth: world_model truth with the 48 strongest wave components

motor.folded_drag: prop.folded_drag_cda_m2 / S with the smooth switch, in the planner and in the true dynamics
motor.perturbation: Gaussian per knot, clipped to [0, T_max]
motor.burst: actual thrust above 0.01 of the weight

w_energy_levels.definition: w_energy = k w_e eta / m (cost per electric joule), k = free 0.03, normal 2, costly 4
w_energy_levels.how_chosen: pilot on the flat sea below the soaring minimum (baseline u10 6, 9, 11, albatross u10 9, 150 s): k 0.03 gives thrust on all the time (about 15 to 28 W); k near 2 gives the planner's working range; above k 4 to 5 the planner stops using the motor before the horizon shows the contact and the flight ends

flap_glide.note: steady flap-glide at best L/D with the same efficiencies (patterns.flap_glide_cost), wind independent

meta.motor_off_rows: case c of margin_exp where it exists (sea, flat planner world); the other motor-off rows are run here without the folded-propeller drag (motor off means no motor in the aircraft)
meta.energy_trend: (E_end - E_start)/(t_end - t_start) * 60 over the last 60 s flown, E = g z + V^2/2 (J/kg per min)

meta.true_wind: Wind(u10, 270, roughness='coare35') (flat sea) and the fully developed sea of seed 1 on that wind (waves): COARE 3.5 as the library and the optimizer; burst_exp used make_env with the Charnock constant. The planner's flat world takes the roughness of the true wind.
meta.thrust_sampling: sustained: half of the samples hold one half-normal level (scale 0.3 T_max) over a random run of knots, the rest independent Gaussian (ctrl.thrust_sigma_frac); candidates with constant thrust [0.05, 0.1, 0.2] of the weight, with the nominal controls and wings level at best L/D
meta.fold_switch: state: in the planner's rollouts and the true dynamics the propeller is folded (full folded drag) when the commanded thrust is below 0.005 of the weight and not folded (zero) otherwise, instead of the smooth switch; the optimizer keeps the smooth one

reflex.prediction: the plan's own controls, flat or truth world of the planner

meta.comparison: burst_exp: the normal-level row of the same aircraft, wind, sea and world (Charnock true wind, margin library, no sustained sampling); optimizer: the library entry at chi 20 deg of the nearest library wind (same margins, no ground effect, smooth fold, speed along chi from the optimizer; power in W is the average electric power)
